name: ZuriQ
description: ZuriQ is an ETH Zurich spin-off developing a trapped-ion quantum computing architecture the company describes as "natively three-dimensional". Unlike conventional one-dimensional ion chain designs, ZuriQ uses combined electric and magnetic fields to move ions in all spatial directions on a quantum chip — including the first native 2D trapped-ion array — addressing the qubit-scaling limitations of current trapped-ion systems.

products.name: 2D Trapped-Ion Quantum Chip
products.description: Novel two-dimensional trapped-ion architecture using combined electric and magnetic fields for free ion movement on a quantum chip

highlights: ETH Zurich spin-off building a natively three-dimensional ion-trap architecture
CHF 3.8M raised to break qubit-scaling limitations of conventional 1D ion chains
Combined electric and magnetic fields move ions in all spatial directions, not just along a chain

news.title: ZuriQ Raises $4.2 Million to Break Quantum Computing's Scaling Barrier
news.excerpt: ZuriQ has raised $4.2 million to commercialize a new trapped-ion architecture. The seed funding round was led by Founderful with participation from SquareOne, First Momentum Ventures, OnSight Ventures and QAI Ventures.
